text.p: China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd's circular containing the details of proposed acquisitions was delayed again and would be issued on July 31, a company statement published on Monday said.

The circular, which would give details on the proposed acquisition of 20 percent of the equity share capital of Everbright Bank of China from parent company China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, was to have been issued on July 21, the statement said.

The circular would also include the details on the conditional acquisition by Theme International Holdings Ltd from the company of a 56 percent interest in Wescorp Ltd and a subscription by the company for 125 million shares in Theme at a price of HK$3.10 per share, it said.
The company, which has already delayed the issue of the circular due to the long handover holiday, said it needed more time to compile the required financial information.
